data.title: Opposites Challenge
data.description: Listen to each word and say its opposite out loud.
data.gradeLevel: elementary students (grades 1-5) - Use age-appropriate vocabulary, concrete examples, structured learning objectives, and interactive elements. Build fundamental understanding.

items.ask: Listen to this word: big. What is the opposite of big?
items.howToPlay: I will ask, and you say the answer out loud.
items.acceptRule: Saying tiny or little counts as the correct opposite.
items.signatureError: Repeating the starting word big is not correct.
items.correctionBody: The opposite of big is small. Things that are not large are small.

actionContract.label: Say the Answer
actionContract.instruction: Listen to this word: big. What is the opposite of big?

items.ask: Listen to this word: happy. What is the opposite of happy?
items.howToPlay: I will ask, and you say the answer out loud.
items.acceptRule: Saying unhappy or upset counts as the correct opposite.
items.signatureError: Repeating the starting word happy is not correct.
items.correctionBody: The opposite of happy is sad. When you are not feeling happy, you feel sad.

actionContract.label: Say the Answer
actionContract.instruction: Listen to this word: happy. What is the opposite of happy?

items.ask: Listen to this word: fast. What is the opposite of fast?
items.howToPlay: I will ask, and you say the answer out loud.
items.acceptRule: Saying sluggish counts as the correct opposite.
items.signatureError: Repeating the starting word fast is not correct.
items.correctionBody: The opposite of fast is slow. Something that does not move quickly is slow.

actionContract.label: Say the Answer
actionContract.instruction: Listen to this word: fast. What is the opposite of fast?

items.ask: Listen to this word: up. What is the opposite of up?
items.howToPlay: I will ask, and you say the answer out loud.
items.signatureError: Repeating the starting word up is not correct.
items.correctionBody: The opposite of up is down. If you do not go up, you go down.

actionContract.label: Say the Answer
actionContract.instruction: Listen to this word: up. What is the opposite of up?

spares.ask: Listen to this word: day. What is the opposite of day?
spares.howToPlay: I will ask, and you say the answer out loud.
spares.signatureError: Repeating the starting word day is not correct.
spares.correctionBody: The opposite of day is night. When the sun goes away, it is night.

actionContract.label: Say the Answer
actionContract.instruction: Listen to this word: day. What is the opposite of day?

spares.ask: Listen to this word: hot. What is the opposite of hot?
spares.howToPlay: I will ask, and you say the answer out loud.
spares.acceptRule: Saying synonyms that mean cold like freezing or chilled counts as the answer.
spares.signatureError: Repeating the starting word hot back as the opposite is not correct.
spares.correctionBody: The opposite of hot is cold. When something is not hot, it is cold.

actionContract.label: Say the Answer
actionContract.instruction: Listen to this word: hot. What is the opposite of hot?
